meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 处理数据任务时，会按操作类型在 DuckDB 与 Polars 之间选工具；一律用 uv 运行并带上 numpy，不用 pandas，优先直接查文件、延迟计算，完成后报告处理时间与行数。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析数据或查看文件内容、做分组或过滤等数据处理、提到 CSV/Parquet 等数据文件时触发；不用于纯文本查看、配置文件或小型内联计算。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件，按类别统计总金额
对比昨天和今天的数据，找出差异
say.note: 会按时间序列比较并给出统计结果。

say.text: 这个文件太大，内存装不下，帮我做分组聚合
say.note: 会改用 Polars 流式或 DuckDB 外存处理。

howto.what_en: On data tasks, selects DuckDB or Polars by operation type; always runs via uv with numpy, never uses pandas, prefers direct file queries and lazy evaluation, and reports processing time and row counts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on data analysis/file inspection requests, grouping/filtering operations, or CSV/Parquet file mentions; not for plain-text viewing, configs, or small inline math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and total amounts by category.
say_en.note: Queries the file with DuckDB, then uses Polars.

say_en.text: Compare yesterday's and today's data and show differences.
say_en.note: Runs a time-series comparison and reports statistics.

say_en.text: This dataset is too large for RAM; aggregate it by group.
say_en.note: Switches to Polars streaming or DuckDB out-of-core execution.
